protocol_amendment.reason: Pre-data FLOP audit showed that an exact-10M one-pass untied fixed-depth frontier cannot match the multi-loop recurrent compute curve beyond the one-loop point without reusing computation; retaining it would bias RCG toward recurrence.

question: At exactly matched 10M resident-parameter budgets and matched accounted inference-compute budgets, does stateful shared recurrence provide reproducible verified-generalization headroom over a stateless repeated-restart fixed-depth Transformer and a simple recurrent rival without protected-domain regressions?

arms.role: fixed-depth 10M Transformer with stateless repeated restarts as the compute-scaling rival
constraints: three untied layers within each fixed-depth pass
each restart begins from the original token embedding plus a frozen parameter-free restart code
no latent state carries across restarts
restart states are mean-aggregated before one final normalization and tied LM projection
accounted FLOPs matched to recurrent operating points within frozen tolerance

arms.role: simple stateful weight-tied recurrent Transformer rival
constraints: same three-layer core repeatedly applied with latent state carry
same three-layer core repeatedly applied with latent state carry
no optional V0.17 sidecars in EXP-301

compute_matching.a_fixed_policy: run exactly effort_multiplier stateless fixed-depth restarts; no cross-restart latent state; mean latent aggregation; one final output projection
compute_matching.b_loop_simple_policy: run exactly effort_multiplier recurrent latent loops with shared weights; one final output projection
compute_matching.c_nrs_core_policy: run exactly effort_multiplier recurrent latent loops with shared weights and frozen loop-conditioning implementation; one final output projection
compute_matching.restart_code: deterministic parameter-free sinusoidal restart-index code, added to the original token embedding before each A_FIXED restart
compute_matching.unmatched_budget_policy: INVALID_COMPUTE_MATCH for all arms at that operating point; never interpolate or repair after outcome

primary_endpoints.verified_success_curve: paired verified task success as a function of accounted inference FLOPs
primary_endpoints.recurrent_compute_gain: normalized area under C_NRS_CORE minus A_FIXED verified-success versus log2(accounted-FLOPs) over valid common budgets

protected_floors: no challenge leakage or generator identity overlap
no >2 percentage-point regression on language-sequence control
no increase in invalid-output rate >0.5 percentage points
resident parameter count and accounted compute validated

decision_rule.promote: C_NRS_CORE must clear all protected floors, achieve RCG >= +0.05 versus A_FIXED, show >= +5pp verified success on at least two reasoning families at one valid common compute budget, and be directionally positive on >=3/4 roots; 95% paired hierarchical-bootstrap CI for aggregate RCG must exclude 0.
decision_rule.kill: Kill H-RD-01 if C_NRS_CORE fails the promote rule without a protocol invalidation. Do not rescue by changing restart policy, loop schedule, thresholds, roots, task-family weights, or compute accounting after outcome.
decision_rule.diagnostic_only: If gains occur only beyond trained loop depths while representation rank collapses or protected controls regress, mark recurrence unstable and authorize only a distinct recurrence-stability hypothesis, not scale.

analysis_plan.statistical_unit: held-out generator instance, paired across arms; train root is replication stratum
analysis_plan.estimator: root-stratified paired hierarchical bootstrap; family-level effects reported separately before aggregate
analysis_plan.missingness: failed or invalid runs remain in ledger; infrastructure-invalid runs may rerun only under frozen rerun policy
analysis_plan.multiplicity: one primary RCG endpoint; family effects are protected/secondary unless explicitly named in rule
anti_goodhart: early stopping that saves FLOPs while increasing wrong answers
looping that improves seen-depth tasks but collapses at unseen depths
fixed rival intentionally under-computed, deterministic-repeated without restart diversity, or under-optimized

posthoc_policy: Any unregistered metric, new task family, altered restart policy, altered loop schedule, or new baseline discovered after challenge materialization is exploratory and cannot authorize EXP-302.
